description: D094 unapproved landscape comparison batch v011. S003 v015 and S004 v028 are the revised selected candidates; S005 v017 is retained. review_notice: Unapproved candidates for comparison only. Fresh independent exact-checksum review is requested for all ten selected candidates against the final plan. S003 v015 replaces v014 with a compact small nape tuft; the disclosed kneeling pose remains and skin-only 11x11 R-B samples range 97–115. S004 v028 is directly selected by Firstmate; Brahma retains four plain matte-ochre crowns and restrained ornaments. S004 skin-only R-B samples range 130–153, a significant measured guide deviation disclosed in the plan. One S004 deity foot overlaps the other; four toe tips are distinct on that foot and the fifth is uncertain. S005 v017 remains selected with a plain chest-covering uttariya, bare forehead, two separate arm paths and a visible thigh hand; its partly occluded head-supporting thumb remains disclosed. S005 skin-only R-B samples range 110–138. All ten rows remain mapped to captioned source photos 001–010; photos 011–014 remain preserved unmapped extras. Art remains unapproved and portraits are paused.

rows.scene: A single all-pervading presence and varied flames evoke the chapter’s first teaching.
rows.candidate_status: Three groups of distinct logs carry small, medium and large flames against the cosmic spiral; no people or text appear. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: The guru instructs an attentive seated disciple beside the two crossed aranis.
rows.candidate_status: Exactly two generic seated figures: the older guru faces and instructs the attentive disciple beside the two crossed aranis; both logs remain distinct beneath a small fire and separate branch tangle. At native and enlarged views each figure has one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; visible hands show five digits and each of four bare feet shows five toes. Skin-only 11x11 medians: guru cheek (545,217) RGB (150,76,38) R-B 112; torso (410,320) (153,77,39) R-B 114; disciple cheek (1280,215) (152,80,43) R-B 109; torso (1295,315) (152,78,40) R-B 112. No readable text. Producer reviewed; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri turns from temporary remedies toward Bhagwan’s refuge.
rows.candidate_status: One older Bhattathiri kneels before one calm blue Bhagwan; the disclosed kneeling pose remains. The nape hair is a compact three-lobed dark tuft close to the shaved scalp, with no trailing strand below the skull contour. Skin-only 11x11 medians at upper-left crop origins: cheek (350,310) RGB (154,83,42) R-B 112; second cheek (360,320) (150,79,40) R-B 110; torso (280,480) (161,86,46) R-B 115; upper arm (250,490) (132,69,35) R-B 97; lower cheek/neck (315,410) (135,71,38) R-B 97; torso (300,450) (153,83,43) R-B 110; arm (320,500) (148,82,44) R-B 104. The maximum measured R-B is 115; samples read warm-brown. Bhattathiri's namaste has five visible fingertip ends with overlapping thumbs; his two visible feet each show five toes. Bhagwan's raised hand shows thumb plus four fingers, his knee hand shows four fingers with thumb naturally occluded, and his two visible feet each show five toes. No added people or text. Fresh producer review v002 is bound to the final plan; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending for all ten; art remains unapproved.

producer_review.outcome: pass with disclosed kneeling pose and skin boundary

rows.scene: Even the highest celestial realm is unsettled; the poet seeks refuge and release.
rows.candidate_status: Firstmate directly reviewed this exact candidate and selected it, judging Bhattathiri's nape to show only a very small dark tuft; the image remains unapproved. Brahma has four distinct heads (three faces visible and one rear-facing head) and four attached arms holding the lotus, rosary, water pot and blank palm-leaf scripture. The four crowns are plain matte ochre; chest, arm and wrist ornaments remain restrained. Skin-only 11x11 medians at sample centers: cheek (697,480) RGB (196,103,52) R-B 144; second cheek (686,467) (206,113,61) R-B 145; torso (651,616) (229,141,99) R-B 130; second torso (635,605) (206,108,56) R-B 150; upper arm (615,650) (207,107,54) R-B 153; second upper arm (627,641) (191,94,48) R-B 143. These warm-brown skin samples exceed the R-B 120 guide (range 130–153) and remain disclosed as a significant numeric deviation. Bhattathiri's joined hands are visible; his dhoti covers the feet. Bhagwan's two attached open hands each show thumb plus four fingers; his viewer-right foot shows five toe tips, while the viewer-left foot overlaps it and only four toe tips are individually clear, so the fifth is uncertain at enlargement. Request independent reviewers to assess this overlap. Fresh producer review v002 is bound to the final plan; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending for all ten; art remains unapproved.

producer_review.outcome: uncertain toe overlap; selected by Firstmate with skin deviation disclosed

rows.scene: One connected tree holds both dream and waking; the reclining figure now has two clearly separated arms, with the second hand visible on the thigh.
rows.candidate_status: One generic reclining figure rests on the connected dream/waking tree with its mango cluster and waking-side lotus. The forehead is plain and bare; no devotional ornaments are visible. A plain opaque warm-cream uttariya fully covers the chest and remains distinct from both arms. The figure has one head, two attached arms from distinct shoulder paths, two legs and two feet; the thigh-resting hand is visible and shows a thumb plus four fingers. The head-supporting hand shows four clear fingers; its thumb is partly occluded at the head contact, disclosed and accepted by Firstmate as previously accepted. Each visible foot shows five toes. Skin-only 11x11 median samples at upper-left crop origins: cheek (215,385) RGB (173,88,37), R-B 136; cheek (225,395) (176,92,40), R-B 136; cheek (235,410) (132,61,22), R-B 110; upper arm (480,430) (152,70,27), R-B 125; arm (520,435) (172,85,34), R-B 138. The recorded range is 110–138; values above the R-B 120 guide are disclosed. Firstmate directly reviewed and selected this version, noting that the exposed skin reads clearly warm brown. Fresh producer review is recorded; independent exact-checksum review pending; art remains unapproved.

producer_review.outcome: pass with accepted thumb occlusion and skin guide deviation disclosed

The enlarged lower-body view shows four attached cow legs and four distinct hooves; the empty bowl and flower remain. Producer-reviewed pass; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.
